# v0.5.13 (2026-08-14)
Signed and notarized Release build of Foundation for macOS arm64.
Defaults to production (`https://foundation.trychroma.com`). Uses the saved default CLI profile.
Includes a bundled `foundation` CLI at `Foundation.app/Contents/Resources/foundation` (same version as this Mac release).
## Opening the app
Open the `.dmg` and drag `Foundation.app` onto Applications. Direct downloads should open normally (Developer ID + notarized).
## Changes
* [BUG](mac): Skip quit prompt on app update (#438) * [ENH](mac): Use "Log out" wording in menu button (#436) * [ENH](mac): Detect installed agent apps and CLIs (#435) * [ENH](mac): Custom DMG drag-to-Applications arrow (#434) * [CLN](mac): Stop publishing the Mac zip (#432) * [ENH](bridge-protocol): accept unknown capability names in schema (#402)
